summary: Bush-backed kerb at the east end, near cars parked both sides.
reasons: Backs onto bush, no dwellings near
Steepens past 15 m; stay at the east end

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind; a gravel car park with parked cars to the north-east; no dwellings within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb; one car parked at the start and a row on the opposite kerb, so a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Through road leading to the bridge; motorway noise further along.
drivers.convention: No signs on this side; cars park along both kerbs here.

flags: Steep: about 6% over the best section; 9% mean over the full line
Max grade 26.7% on the bridge approach
sun_shade: Bush shade from the north and east; open to the south and west.
cannot_judge: Whether the kerb is a clear parking lane

best_section.where: Russell Terrace north kerb, east end beside the bush before the motorway bridge
